claim.body: gen_s and weather_risk are the same morning S (down==off). Survival is therefore scored on joint weather×prior-SPY cells so a tag that is only tested on up-tape is not an invariant. `hot+ab+peer` can look perfect on the cells it reaches and still be thin on risk-off. That is a clean-enough null for a live promote, with a ranked short-list for the next window.
